The main takeaway from our work is that

the light activatable nano DDS is able to not only improve the therapeutic efficacy of PDT by alleviating the ACQ effect of photosensitizers but also synergistically facilitate the release of chemotherapeutic drugs by generating ROS under laser irradiation.

the combination of chemotherapy with PDT has promising applications in cancer theranostics and the rational design of nano DDS with a light activatable PDT shell and a chemotherapy core can be used for efficient synergistic cancer therapy.
